description: Site clearance: Clearing bushes, shrubs and small trees including grubbing up roots and carting away
Excavation: Topsoil excavation average 200mm deep and preserving for landscaping
Bulk excavation: Excavate in normal soil to reduce levels not exceeding 1.50m deep
Foundation trenches: Excavate for strip foundations not exceeding 1.50m deep
Plunking and strutting to sides of all excavations
Hardcore bed: 300mm thick compacted approved quarry hardcore bed in layers
Murram blinding: 50mm thick approved murram blinding rolled smooth to receive polythene
Damp-proof membrane: 1000 gauge polythene damp-proof membrane with 200mm laps
Anti-termite treatment: Approved chemical insecticide applied to blinded hardcore
Mass concrete: Plain concrete Class 1:4:8 (15/20) in 50mm blinding under foundations
Vibrated reinforced concrete: Class 1:2:4 (20/20) in strip foundation footings
Reinforcement: High yield deformed rebar bars (Y10 and Y12) to BS 4449 in foundations
BRC Mesh: Fabric reinforcement ref A142 weighing 2.22 kg/m2 in 150mm ground slab
Natural stone walling: 200mm thick approved medium quarry stone walling in foundation
Reinforced concrete Class 25/20: In ground floor columns, ring beams and suspended slab
High tensile rebar: Y16 and Y20 bars to BS 4449 in columns and transfer beams
Sawn formwork: Formwork to soffits of suspended slabs, sides of beams and columns
Machine-cut stone walling: 200mm thick chisel-dressed stone walling bedded in cement mortar 1:3
Structural steel roof trusses: Fabricated structural steel roof trusses primed with red oxide
Roof covering: 28 gauge prepainted box profile roofing sheets fixed with self-tapping screws
Internal plaster: 15mm thick cement and sand (1:4) plaster with steel trowelled finish
Floor tiling: 600x600mm porcelain floor tiles bedded in cementitious tile adhesive with grey grout
External wall finishes: Acrylic textured wall coating (Roughcast / Wallmaster finish)
Provisional Sum: Contingency sum for unforeseen site conditions to be expended at Architect instruction
Provisional Sum: Electrical installation by licensed EPRA contractor
Provisional Sum: Plumbing, drainage and sanitation installations
